findings.issue: Missing methods from fiado.sql queries. The Querier interface does not include GetCustomerByUserIDAndID, ListPendingFiadoSalesByCustomer, or SummarizePendingFiadoSalesByCustomer. Code in pending.go and main.go references these methods, but they don't exist in the generated interface. Build will fail.
Discarded validity flag from timestamptzTime. If row.SaleDate is invalid (NULL in DB), the code silently uses time.Time zero value. Validity information is lost.
Test asserts 2 sales exist (len(out.Data) != 2) but only inspects the first one (out.Data[0]). The second sale should be verified for correctness.
FailureResponse is defined in both fiado/types.go and sync/types.go. The sync version has an additional 'Error' field. Duplicated type definitions should be consolidated.

Function numericFloat is defined in 3 different places: fiado_integration_test.go:19, pending.go:94, and sync/pgconv.go:11. Code duplication violates DRY principle. Should share a common utility or move to a shared package.
